rules.rule: Consider adding routing and interactivity to the native `page` component so the bot has a reason to use it instead of always falling back to the sandbox component.

rules.quote: Fix data_table empty cells first (most visible demo-killer).
rules.rule: When fixing the open QA issues, fix the data_table empty-cells bug before the other remaining issues.

rules.quote: Dashboard redirect needs client-side investigation.
rules.rule: When investigating the dashboard auto-redirect to /d/[id], investigate it on the client side.

rules.quote: If prompt-level changes continue to fail, implement API-level enforcement in tamboAgent.ts
rules.rule: If prompt-level changes continue to fail to make the bot use the sandbox, implement API-level enforcement in tamboAgent.ts.

rules.quote: when the bot emits 3+ typed component blocks (metric_card/chart/data_table) in a single response, auto-convert to a single sandbox component
rules.rule: In tamboAgent.ts, when the bot emits 3 or more typed component blocks (metric_card, chart, or data_table) in a single response, automatically convert them into a single sandbox component.

rules.quote: Next session should focus on action-oriented testing, then merge to main.
rules.rule: In the next session, focus on action-oriented testing first, then merge the branch to main.

rules.quote: When making architecture decisions, consider inter-pod communication, service discovery, compute distribution, and marketplace economics.
rules.rule: When making architecture decisions, consider inter-pod communication.

rules.quote: When making architecture decisions, consider inter-pod communication, service discovery, compute distribution, and marketplace economics.
rules.rule: When making architecture decisions, consider service discovery.

rules.quote: When making architecture decisions, consider inter-pod communication, service discovery, compute distribution, and marketplace economics.
rules.rule: When making architecture decisions, consider compute distribution.

rules.quote: When making architecture decisions, consider inter-pod communication, service discovery, compute distribution, and marketplace economics.
rules.rule: When making architecture decisions, consider marketplace economics.

rules.quote: The UI system should support both end-user interaction AND programmatic service consumption.
rules.rule: Design the UI system to support end-user interaction.

rules.quote: The UI system should support both end-user interaction AND programmatic service consumption.
rules.rule: Design the UI system to support programmatic service consumption.

rules.quote: Design agent configs to be portable/forkable
rules.rule: Design agent configs to be portable and forkable.

rules.quote: avoid hard-coupling agent state to a specific user or pod
rules.rule: Avoid hard-coupling agent state to a specific user or pod.

rules.quote: Should use a non-root user with minimal permissions.
rules.rule: Run pod containers as a non-root user with minimal permissions instead of root (uid 0).

rules.quote: Mount secrets as files instead of env vars:
rules.rule: Mount secrets as files instead of exposing them as environment variables.

rules.quote: Disable auto-mounting:
rules.rule: Disable auto-mounting of the Kubernetes service account token in the pod spec (automountServiceAccountToken: false).

rules.quote: Add NetworkPolicy allowing only:
rules.rule: Restrict pod egress with a NetworkPolicy that allows only the listed destinations (LLM provider APIs, messaging platforms, DNS, and the jarble-api service).

rules.quote: Drop all and add only required:
rules.rule: Drop all Linux capabilities and add back only those strictly required by the container.

rules.quote: these need to be applied to the pod spec:
rules.rule: Apply CPU and memory resource limits and requests to the pod spec rather than relying only on the database values.

rules.quote: Detect your platform and respond accordingly:
rules.rule: Detect which platform you are running on and respond accordingly.

rules.quote: Use plain text/markdown only
rules.rule: When not on the Jarble web dashboard, respond using plain text/markdown only.

rules.quote: If no [CANVAS_STATE] is present, assume you are NOT on the dashboard.
rules.rule: If the message contains no [CANVAS_STATE] marker, assume you are not on the Jarble web dashboard.

rules.quote: When building deploy infrastructure, follow this plan.
rules.rule: When building deploy infrastructure, follow the staging-to-production pipeline plan in this file.

rules.quote: When adding schema changes, use expand/contract pattern.
rules.rule: When adding schema changes, use the expand/contract migration pattern.

rules.quote: never add NOT NULL without default
rules.rule: Never add a NOT NULL column without a default value.

rules.quote: never rename columns in single deploy
rules.rule: Never rename a column in a single deploy.

rules.quote: Same Hetzner K3s cluster, separate namespace (not a second cluster)
rules.rule: Host staging on the same Hetzner K3s cluster as production, in a separate namespace, not in a second cluster.

rules.quote: Image SHA pinning (no `:latest`)
rules.rule: Pin container images by SHA and never use the `:latest` tag.

rules.quote: same image promoted staging → prod
rules.rule: Promote the same image from staging to production rather than building a new one.

rules.quote: fork prod → test migrations → if green, run on main
rules.rule: Test migrations on a Neon branch forked from production first, and run them on the main database only if the test is green.

rules.quote: run migrations once before app starts, not per-pod in CMD
rules.rule: Run database migrations once via a Kubernetes init container before the app starts, not per-pod in the container CMD.

rules.quote: validate DB connectivity + schema version, not just `{ status: "ok" }`
rules.rule: The /health endpoint should validate database connectivity and schema version, not just return a static ok status.

rules.quote: `maxUnavailable: 0, maxSurge: 1` in deployment.yaml
rules.rule: Use a rolling update strategy with maxUnavailable: 0 and maxSurge: 1 in deployment.yaml.

rules.quote: build → deploy staging → smoke test → promote to prod
rules.rule: In the GitHub Actions workflow, build, deploy to staging, run a smoke test, and only then promote to production, in that order.

rules.quote: Delete local.db as workaround for now.
rules.rule: As a temporary workaround for the local SQLite startup crash, delete local.db.

rules.quote: Implement in 5 phases
rules.rule: Implement the team-to-deployment bridge work in 5 phases.

rules.quote: each independently shippable
rules.rule: Make each implementation phase independently shippable.

rules.quote: Keep JSON-in-response for now with improved feedback loop
rules.rule: Keep the JSON-in-response delegation mechanism for now, and improve its feedback loop, rather than replacing it.

rules.quote: Plan MCP tool migration as Phase 5
rules.rule: Plan the MCP tool migration as Phase 5 of the implementation.
